parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter will be removed in the future.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the data synchronization instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SubscriptionInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the [DescribeSubscriptionInstances](~~49442~~) operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: SubscriptionObject
parameters.description: The objects from which you want to track data changes. The value is a JSON string and can contain regular expressions. For more information, see [SubscriptionObjects](~~141902~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts modify-subscription-object --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subscription-instance-id dtsl8zl9ek62920000 --subscription-object DBName_:_dtstestdata --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
